title: Walnut Pilaf Bites
description: A Japanese-inspired snack combining the crunch of walnuts with the simplicity of a pilaf, perfect for a quick pick-me-up.
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together sesame oil and rice. Let sit for 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine pilaf, rice mixture, and chopped walnuts. Mix well.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the mixture into balls. Flatten slightly into patties.
Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for 15-20 minutes or until lightly browned.
